name: 7-TOED PETE (DOMINOES VARIANT)
description: Seven-Toed Pete is a connecting domino game in the Fives family played with a double-six set. Four players build a cross-shaped layout from a single spinner, scoring whenever the open ends total a multiple of five and taking extra turns for scoring plays or doubles.

content.text: Seven-Toed Pete is a connecting domino game in the Fives family played with a double-six set. Four players build a cross-shaped layout from a single spinner, scoring whenever the open ends total a multiple of five and taking extra turns for scoring plays or doubles.
Seven-Toed Pete is an American domino game in the Fives family, using a double-six set and scoring on multiples of five.
Four players in the basic game; two or three players can play a draw variant with a boneyard.
Double-six domino set, scoring chips or markers
For four players, each receives seven tiles and there is no boneyard. For two or three players, each receives seven tiles and the remaining tiles form a boneyard to draw from when unable to play.
